messages:
Maya Lin: Quick kickoff 10 we need a compact newsletter + webinar RSVP flow tied to the benchmark release. KPI: webinar RSVPs + report downloads. Thinking 3 core emails + 2 post-event followups.
Tom Brooks: I9ll do segments. Proposed: customers (AE-only), active trials, engaged list (opens in last 60d), and low-engage (no opens 90d). Different CTA per segment.
Elena Ruiz: Creative/subject plan: A/B subject test (personalized first-name vs metric-led). Also test hero image vs plain-text to protect deliverability.
Deliverability Bot: Note: if send >20k use list-splitting with 10-15m gaps. Ensure List-Unsubscribe header present and plain-text body version included. New subdomain must be warmed for 7 days.
Tom Brooks: Segment filters (export-ready): customers: tag:customer AND active_30d:true; trials: tag:trial AND event_14d:gte; engaged: opens_60d:gte2; low_engage: opens_90d:0.
Elena Ruiz: Copy brief: Invite = 1-line hook + 3 bullets on takeaways + CTA. Reminder = add speaker creds + 1 teased datapoint. Last-chance = social proof + countdown. Post 1 = recording + 3 takeaways. Post 2 = highlights + download link. Use UTMs: utm_campaign=bench_fall, utm_source=email, utm_medium=newsletter, utm_content={{seg}}_{{var}}
Maya Lin: Ops Bot 1 create campaign skeleton and checklist. Assign segments (Tom), subjects & copy (Elena), deliverability QA (Tom). Dry-run 3 days before send.
Ops Bot: Campaign created: "Benchmark Fall 1 Mini Nurture". Tasks assigned with due dates and owners. Dry-run scheduled.
Tom Brooks: QA notes: seed to internal inboxes (support, product, 3 personal), test personalization on 100 samples, confirm image CDN loads and tracking pixels. If seed spam rate >0.4% hold.
Elena Ruiz: For low-engage cohort avoid personalization and heavy images. Keep copy short, link-first.
Maya Lin: Great. I'll draft short invite copy and drop in the doc by EOD. Thanks team :sparkles:
